people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

translations.web: When he saw that, he arose, and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
translations.bsb: And Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,
translations.kjv: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
translations.asv: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
